title: shaderera.json
description: A Shaderera project's manifest, format manifest/1: plain data the tools read without running code. Nothing in it says what a frame shows. The CLI checks the file itself and lists every problem; this schema is editor help.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file against: the shaderera package's, ./node_modules/shaderera/shaderera.schema.json.

shaderera.description: The file's format. A file without it is manifest/1 too; any other format is refused.

entry.description: The module that default-exports the Open or Source, relative to the project root.

params.description: A JSON Schema (type: object) of what the host passes to open.

seed.description: The only randomness a source may use.

sequential.description: true: state carries from frame to frame; or a whole number, the lookback in frames.

host.description: The host every tool opens: node (the default) or browser.

dom.description: A module that default-exports a MountDom. Needs "host": "browser".

domScale.description: Pixels per CSS pixel the browser host draws dom with. Needs dom.

stamp.description: Source stamps: every object literal with an id gets source: "file:line:col".

variants.description: Named outputs the film is designed for: sizes, lengths, params. Never a crop.

bakes.description: Frames made outside the host, by name (letters, digits, . _ -).

requires.description: What the project needs installed. shaderera add and remove keep extensions; every command refuses a project whose requirements are not met.

shaderera.description: A range of the shaderera package, such as ^0.1.5.

extensions.description: Package plugins by npm name, each with a range.

fps.description: Frames a second: a number or a fraction such as "24000/1001". 23.976, 29.97 and 59.94 mean their fractions.

preroll.description: Time before the programme in the delivered file: seconds of black, or of the source at negative t.

timecode.description: The programme's start timecode, HH:MM:SS:FF (HH:MM:SS;FF drop-frame).

textless.description: A textless version: review fails it when inspect or the DOM shows text.

command.description: What makes the frames, run by shaderera bake in the project folder; a render never runs it.

inputs.description: The project files and folders the frames derive from.

dir.description: Where the command writes the frames.

frames.description: Their names, one run of # for the frame number: beauty.####.jpg.
